discrepancies.source: ego_grasp README.md / VALIDATION_REPORT.json vs HuggingFace file listing
discrepancies.note: README and validation report claim 7,697 clips; Hugging Face lists and file_eval probed 15,587 MP4 files under ego_grasp/clips/.
README claims 10h04m; ffprobe sums all local MP4 durations to 7.444h.

discrepancies.claimed: 7,697 annotated clips align to video clips
discrepancies.actual: environment annotations match 5,112 of 15,587 MP4 stems; 2,585 annotation stems have no matching MP4 stem in API listing
discrepancies.note: README coverage is reported over the 7,697 validated clip set; file_eval video metrics cover every MP4 exposed under ego_grasp/clips/.

annotation_coverage_note: Annotation files were not bulk-downloaded because Hugging Face rate-limited the 45k tiny JSON/JSONL files. Coverage values are copied from the dataset README and validation report. The empirical ffprobe pass covers all 15,587 local MP4 files.
